import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/dogs_zurich.csv')

# Set style
plt.style.use('seaborn-v0_8-whitegrid')
sns.set_palette("husl")

# Create figure with subplots
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(20, 16))

# 1. Top 10 dog breeds by count
ax1 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 1)
top_breeds = df['Rasse1Text'].value_counts().head(10)
bars = ax1.barh(range(len(top_breeds)), top_breeds.values)
ax1.set_yticks(range(len(top_breeds)))
ax1.set_yticklabels(top_breeds.index, fontsize=9)
ax1.invert_yaxis()
ax1.set_xlabel('Number of Dogs')
ax1.set_title('Top 10 Dog Breeds in Zurich', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
for i, v in enumerate(top_breeds.values):
    ax1.text(v + top_breeds.values.max()*0.01, i, f'{v:,}', va='center', fontsize=8)

# 2. Dog distribution by district
ax2 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 2)
district_counts = df['KreisLang'].value_counts().sort_index()
bars = ax2.bar(range(len(district_counts)), district_counts.values)
ax2.set_xticks(range(len(district_counts)))
ax2.set_xticklabels([f'Kreis {i+1}' for i in range(len(district_counts))], rotation=45, ha='right', fontsize=8)
ax2.set_xlabel('District')
ax2.set_ylabel('Number of Dogs')
ax2.set_title('Dog Distribution by District', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax2.ticklabel_format(style='plain', axis='y')

# 3. Dog gender distribution
ax3 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 3)
gender_counts = df['SexHundLang'].value_counts()
colors = ['#FF6B6B', '#4ECDC4']
wedges, texts, autotexts = ax3.pie(gender_counts.values, labels=gender_counts.index, 
                                    autopct='%1.1f%%', startangle=90, colors=colors)
for autotext in autotexts:
    autotext.set_color('white')
    autotext.set_fontweight('bold')
ax3.set_title('Dog Gender Distribution', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')

# 4. Dog age distribution
ax4 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 4)
age_order = sorted(df['AlterVHundLang'].dropna().unique(), 
                   key=lambda x: int(x.split('-')[0]) if '-' in x else int(x.split()[0]))
age_counts = df['AlterVHundLang'].value_counts().reindex(age_order)
bars = ax4.bar(range(len(age_counts)), age_counts.values)
ax4.set_xticks(range(len(age_counts)))
ax4.set_xticklabels(age_counts.index, rotation=45, ha='right', fontsize=8)
ax4.set_xlabel('Age Group')
ax4.set_ylabel('Number of Dogs')
ax4.set_title('Dog Age Distribution', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')

# 5. Owner age distribution
ax5 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 5)
owner_age_order = sorted(df['AlterV10Lang'].dropna().unique(), 
                         key=lambda x: int(x.split('-')[0]) if '-' in x else int(x.split()[0]))
owner_age_counts = df['AlterV10Lang'].value_counts().reindex(owner_age_order)
bars = ax5.bar(range(len(owner_age_counts)), owner_age_counts.values, color='#95E1D3')
ax5.set_xticks(range(len(owner_age_counts)))
ax5.set_xticklabels(owner_age_counts.index, rotation=45, ha='right', fontsize=8)
ax5.set_xlabel('Owner Age Group')
ax5.set_ylabel('Number of Owners')
ax5.set_title('Dog Owner Age Distribution', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')

# 6. Dogs per year trend
ax6 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 6)
year_counts = df['StichtagDatJahr'].value_counts().sort_index()
ax6.plot(year_counts.index, year_counts.values, marker='o', linewidth=2, markersize=6, color='#FF9A76')
ax6.fill_between(year_counts.index, year_counts.values, alpha=0.3, color='#FF9A76')
ax6.set_xlabel('Year')
ax6.set_ylabel('Number of Dogs Registered')
ax6.set_title('Dog Registrations Over Time', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax6.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
ax6.ticklabel_format(style='plain', axis='y')

# 7. Top dog colors
ax7 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 7)
color_counts = df['HundefarbeText'].value_counts().head(8)
bars = ax7.bar(range(len(color_counts)), color_counts.values, color=['#F38181', '#95E1D3', '#FCE38A', '#EAFFD0', '#B5EAD7', '#C7CEEA', '#FFDAC1', '#E2F0CB'])
ax7.set_xticks(range(len(color_counts)))
ax7.set_xticklabels(color_counts.index, rotation=45, ha='right', fontsize=8)
ax7.set_xlabel('Dog Color')
ax7.set_ylabel('Count')
ax7.set_title('Most Common Dog Colors', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')

# 8. Breed type distribution
ax8 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 8)
breed_type_counts = df['Rassetyp1Lang'].value_counts()
bars = ax8.bar(range(len(breed_type_counts)), breed_type_counts.values, color='#A8E6CF')
ax8.set_xticks(range(len(breed_type_counts)))
ax8.set_xticklabels(breed_type_counts.index, rotation=45, ha='right', fontsize=8)
ax8.set_xlabel('Breed Type')
ax8.set_ylabel('Count')
ax8.set_title('Dog Breed Type Distribution', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')

# 9. Dogs per owner (based on HID)
ax9 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 9)
dogs_per_owner = df['HID'].value_counts().value_counts().sort_index().head(10)
bars = ax9.bar(range(len(dogs_per_owner)), dogs_per_owner.values, color='#FFAAA5')
ax9.set_xticks(range(len(dogs_per_owner)))
ax9.set_xticklabels(dogs_per_owner.index, fontsize=9)
ax9.set_xlabel('Number of Dogs')
ax9.set_ylabel('Number of Owners')
ax9.set_title('Dogs per Owner Distribution', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
for i, v in enumerate(dogs_per_owner.values):
    ax9.text(i, v + dogs_per_owner.values.max()*0.01, f'{v:,}', ha='center', fontsize=8)

# Adjust layout and add main title
plt.suptitle('Zurich Dog Registration Analysis\nComprehensive Overview of Canine Population', 
             fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)
plt.tight_layout()

# Save the figure
